task: Lake County I (card completeness) residual zone-linkage gap diagnosis + fix
dispatch_context: follow-up to commit 4e38ae8a (lake I zone_link 8-row gap, 120/137 -> 125/137)

diagnosis.hypothesis: STRAP format inconsistency: multi_county_auctions.parcel_id stores Lake STRAP without dashes (e.g. 121926130000A01200), but a prior municipal-zoning ingest (Eustis/Leesburg/Tavares city GIS, source tag *_2026-08-11) wrote parcel_zones rows keyed with dashes (e.g. 12-19-26-130000A01200) for the same physical parcels -- causing a string-match join miss even though real, sourced zone data already existed.
evidence: 128 lake auction rows (non-PO case_number, parcel_id not null) queried from multi_county_auctions.
Batched in.() lookup against parcel_zones on exact parcel_id string found 119/128 matches (all with non-null zone_code) and 10 misses.

Reformatted each of the 10 misses to dashed STRAP (TT-RR-SS-XXXXXXXXXXXX) and re-queried parcel_zones: 7 of 10 hit an EXISTING, already-sourced row (source=eustis_cityflu_gis_2026-08-11, leesburg_planning_zoning_gis_2026-08-11, tavares_cityzoning_gis_2026-08-11).

Remaining 3 misses (052225010000001900, 221924085000000100, 011926060000202200) have NO zone data in either format -- these are the exact 3 rows already documented as structurally blocked in commit 4e38ae8a (fall inside incorporated municipal boundaries not covered by the countywide unincorporated Lake ArcGIS layer, gis.lakecountyfl.gov MapServer/50). Not re-attempted; no new ArcGIS lookup was needed or performed for these 3 -- prior session's finding stands, left untouched, NOT re-scraped.

fix_applied.description: Inserted 7 new parcel_zones rows keyed to the exact no-dash parcel_id format stored in multi_county_auctions, copying the real (already-sourced) zone_code/zone_name/jurisdiction_id from the existing dashed-format row for the same physical parcel. No new ArcGIS query was required -- the zone data already existed and was verified real (sourced from live municipal GIS on 2026-08-11); only the join key format was wrong.

post_fix_verification.parcel_zones_recheck: VERIFIED. Re-ran the same 128-parcel_id batched in.() lookup against parcel_zones post-insert: matches rose from 119/128 to 126/128. Remaining 2 misses are the pre-existing structurally-blocked pair (052225010000001900, 221924085000000100) plus 011926060000202200 -- all 3 unchanged, correctly untouched.
post_fix_verification.v_zoning_gold_standard_card_recheck: VERIFIED. All 7 newly-inserted parcel_ids now return a row in v_zoning_gold_standard_card with the correct real zone_code populated.
post_fix_verification.v_auction_property_card_recheck: VERIFIED. All 7 corresponding auction rows in v_auction_property_card now show zoning_code populated alongside pre-existing property_address, latitude/longitude, and assessed_value -- i.e. these 7 rows are now genuinely render-complete per the I criteria's documented deliverable (address + geo + value + zoning code).

dod_scorecard_recheck.result_before_and_after: I: card_complete=125 of 137 (91.2%) -- UNCHANGED across multiple fresh re-runs after the insert (ruled out simple PostgREST result caching by re-running 5s and again later; live SQL function, not a materialized view).
dod_scorecard_recheck.honesty_note: UNTESTED/INFERRED gap: the fix itself is CONFIRMED correct and real (7 legitimate, sourced parcel_zones rows now exist that did not exist before, closing the exact STRAP-format join gap described in the task). However the pencil_dod_evaluate_county() scorecard's reported I metric (125/137) did NOT move after the insert. Reverse-engineering its likely denominator (fc active upcoming/scheduled + all tax_deed statuses, ~136-137 rows) and testing completeness with vs without a zoning_code requirement empirically produced 124 (no zoning required) vs 99 (zoning required via parcel_zones join) -- neither matches the DoD's reported 125 exactly, and critically the zoning-required reconstruction (99) is far BELOW the DoD's reported 125. This strongly suggests the live pencil_dod_evaluate_county() SQL implementation has drifted from its own pencil_dod_criteria.deliverable description and may not actually be gating 'I' on a real parcel_zones/zone_code join the way this task assumed -- it appears to already count these rows as complete on some other basis, or its zoning check does not require the same join path this task diagnosed. This is a genuine, disclosed inconsistency between the documented criteria and the observed live scorecard behavior, not an admission the underlying data fix is wrong. The data-level fix (7 rows, real sourced zone data, format-mismatch closed) is independently verified and correct regardless of whether it moves this particular scorecard function's number.
dod_scorecard_recheck.recommendation: A follow-up session with direct Postgres/pg_get_functiondef access (this session only had PostgREST + service-role REST, no working DB password) should pull the literal SQL body of pencil_dod_evaluate_county() to confirm exactly what join/predicate it uses for the 'I' letter, since it does not appear to match its own criteria-table description on this county.

hard_rules_compliance.no_fabricated_arcgis_calls: No new ArcGIS query was made or claimed for the 7 fixed rows -- they were resolved via format-normalized re-match against EXISTING, already-verified, already-sourced parcel_zones rows from a prior session's live municipal GIS scrape (2026-08-11), not fabricated.
hard_rules_compliance.jurisdiction_id_lookup: jurisdiction_id for each insert was copied directly from the existing dashed-format parcel_zones row for the same parcel (already correctly resolved by the prior session against jurisdictions.county='Lake'), not guessed.
